title: Edge (typed, weighted relations)
description: cites: source->claim, weight = extraction fidelity in [0,1], LR = likelihood ratio (clamped [0.1,10] by the propagator). derives_from: source->origin (the correlation edge). supports/refutes: claim->conclusion|hypothesis. corroborates/contradicts: claim->claim. depends_on flagged load_bearing drives the weakest-link cap. hypothesis_scores (CC/C/N/I/II) only on cites edges into ACH. v3 L0 fields (LR_raw/LR_cal/estimator_id/calmap_ref) arrive with the input-calibration loop.
